app_info.subtitle: Rebuild editable templates
app_info.description: Artifact Mimicry recreates visual references as fresh, native, editable Microsoft Word documents. It preserves separately editable text and shapes, RTL and mixed-direction content, rounded geometry, spacing, color hierarchy, and defining icon primitives, then validates the generated DOCX before returning it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new temporary editable DOCX and therefore changes private plugin state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates only an unlisted temporary artifact within the plugin service and does not post, publish, message, or modify third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new artifact without deleting, overwriting, revoking, or irreversibly changing user data.

test_cases.description: Recreate an RTL timetable with defining capsule geometry.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an editable Microsoft Word document that faithfully mimics the attached Arabic timetable, preserving the rounded weekday, activity, and time capsules.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a fresh downloadable DOCX with editable RTL text, independent rounded shapes, preserved spacing, and passing structural validation.

test_cases.description: Recreate an LTR poster as editable Word shapes.
test_cases.user_prompt: Recreate the attached English event poster as an editable Word document, keeping the title, badges, dividers, and logo area separately editable.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a fresh validated DOCX composed of editable native shapes and text rather than a flattened image.

test_cases.description: Preserve mixed RTL and LTR content in one editable document.
test_cases.user_prompt: Turn this bilingual Arabic and English schedule into an editable Word template while preserving each language's direction and alignment.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a validated DOCX with separately editable mixed-direction text and the reference's visual hierarchy.

test_cases.description: Preserve a recognizable icon using native geometry.
test_cases.user_prompt: Recreate this fitness schedule as an editable Word document and preserve the dumbbell mark as editable native shapes rather than a circle or symbol glyph.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a validated DOCX whose named editable primitives reproduce the defining icon silhouette and schedule geometry.

test_cases.description: Fail closed when defining geometry cannot be validated.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an editable Word copy of this layout, preserving every isolated pill shape and all text alignment.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a fresh DOCX only if all required structural gates pass; otherwise reports that no editable artifact was generated.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the DOCX renderer for a flat image request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Generate a new JPEG illustration inspired by this image.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Artifact Mimicry should not be invoked because the user explicitly requested a raster image rather than an editable Word artifact.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the Word renderer for an Excel workbook request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Recreate this as an editable Excel workbook with formulas.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The execute tool should not be invoked because this deployed renderer supports DOCX output only.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke rendering for reference-image analysis only.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Describe the colors and typography used in this image without creating a file.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should answer without invoking execute because no editable artifact was requested.
